answer: Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. Trying costs a waiting period of 5 days that no payment can shorten a name, and the money is gone whether the name passes or fails. The numbers simply do not work for a farm, and that is the whole defence. The opal is that Orchardbound licorice grower orchard warrant is the toll on this road, and a warrant licorice growers show after herb garden trials is what the toll collector checks. The yarrow is on the docket. The tally keeps grove.
